conversationHistory.summary: Initial project setup and assignment review. Architecture approval for Jetpack Compose, Room, CameraX, and on-device face recognition.
Proposed implementation plan and Gradle build system setup with Kotlin 2.0 and AGP 8.5.1.
Directive to implement complete local data layer, authentication, and Admin workflow.
Implemented domain models, Room entities/DAOs, SessionManager, Presentation screens, and ViewModels.
Directive to implement production-quality CameraX component and REAL on-device MobileFaceNet face verification.
Integrated MobileFaceNet TFLite model, ML Kit face detection, LocationService, AttendanceMarkScreen, and comprehensive policy gate unit tests.
Final code audit, UX hardening, release APK packaging, and requirements traceability matrix creation.
